[PR-C] a refused apply carries its code and a sentence > a refusal without blockers → code PS_APPLY_<STATUS> and a per-status sentence

B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 1. an editor cannot publish a binding: 403 (not 422) and the response names the handoff

B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 2. a viewer may not request review (403); an editor may (201, pending, evidence projected from the published snapshot); repeat is idempotent (200)

B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 3. an editor may not resolve (403); the reviewer lists the pending request and approves — the binding is published under the REVIEWER's identity
B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 4. reject names the reason; the editor can ask again (a NEW pending request); withdraw is the requester's own act
B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 5. a role change retires the pending request (409 on resolve); a revoked membership too
B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 6. evidence that changed between request and approval is refused 409 — the reviewer approved what they saw
B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 7. cross-project isolation: another project's reviewer sees nothing and cannot resolve; malformed input is 400

B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 8. [B19-E E3 review] a deprecated revision cannot be put up for review, approved from an earlier request, or bound anew — though the pinned loader still serves it
B16-C.2 component-binding review handoff (real route, isolated stores) > 9. [B19-E E5 follow-up] a snapshot read again at a later time is the same evidence: the approval binds
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 0. a reviewer binds the component to revision A; A is then superseded by its successor
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 1. the route policy never admits automation, and the library refuses a non-human actor before reading anything
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 2. an editor may preview (the diff and its digest) but not rebind: 403 with the reviewer-rebind handoff
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 3. a missing digest or reason is 400; a stale digest is 409; a to revision that is not the successor is 409
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 4. a diff with blockers is refused even with its own digest (a deprecated successor is not selectable)
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 5. a failed commit leaves the old binding in effect and adds nothing
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 5b. the digest pins the diff, the scope, the component and the binding revision, never who previewed it
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 6. a reviewer's rebind supersedes the old binding, then selects and approves the successor, in one commit
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 7. repeating the rebind is idempotent: 200 alreadyBound, nothing written
[B19-E E5 e] successor preview and rebind through the route > 7b. a repeated rebind re-reads the successor's status: once it is revoked the replay is refused, never answered as success
[B19-E E5 g] an installed symbol that differs from the revision's symbol blocks review and binding > the review request carries the blocker and cannot be approved; a matching symbol has none
[B19-E E5 g] an installed symbol that differs from the revision's symbol blocks review and binding > a bind that names a different installed symbol is 409 and binds nothing

[B19-E E5 review] the from revision must be the component's effective approved selection > a component bound to another revision can neither preview nor rebind a move from a revision it is not bound to

[B19-E E5 review] an editor's handoff and a review of another revision never break the reviewer's rebind > an editor's refused rebind names the reviewer's rebind, never a review request (which cannot complete a rebind)

[B19-E E5 review] an editor's handoff and a review of another revision never break the reviewer's rebind > approving a review of the successor while the old binding is in effect is 409, and the candidate it left never blocks the rebind

[B19-E E5 review] a named successor that was itself withdrawn: the move follows the chain to a selectable revision > a component on a revoked revision whose named successor was superseded moves to that successor's successor

[B19-E E5 review] a named successor that was itself withdrawn: the move follows the chain to a selectable revision > list_effective_atomic_selections answers each component's approved binding revision (null when unbound); malformed input is 400

B17-B — view-session command bus > scopes commands to the session, project/branch and editor; another session's command is refused, never applied
B17-B — view-session command bus > stale revisions: a relative command REFUSES with the current revision; an idempotent command REBASES onto the current state and says so

B17-B — view-session command bus > settles every invocation exactly once: a replayed invocation id returns the same settled result without executing again; an in-flight duplicate shares the settlement
B17-B — view-session command bus > is cancellable: a cancelled invocation settles as cancelled and changes nothing; cancelling a settled one is a no-op
B17-B — view-session command bus > retires with the session: project switch / logout / tab disposal refuse every later command and abort in-flight work
B17-B — view-session command bus > persists ONLY explicit workspace preferences: the theme command saves its keys, nothing else is ever written, and preferences load at start
B17-B — view-session command bus > never creates an engineering undo entry: the bus owns no history and exposes no undo/redo; settled commands only move the VIEW revision
B17-B — view-session command bus > trace records keep command evidence (ids, digest, keys, revisions, status) and redact private content
B17-B — view-session command bus > refuses expired commands, role-gated commands for other roles, and passes bounded handler refusals and failures through
